bio: Having devoted his career to Cantonese cuisine, Chef Kenichi Takase refined his craft through regular visits to Hong Kong, gaining a deep understanding of its culinary traditions. While he once sought to faithfully reproduce authentic flavours, he now brings a more innovative approach, combining Japanese ingredients with Cantonese techniques. The defining element of his cooking lies in house-made sauces prepared from domestic produce. He composes every dish with meticulous attention to each ingredient, drawing on seasonal delicacies from both land and sea to convey the essence of the four seasons.
